name: travel pace
lore:
To traverse the wilds is to choose a heartbeat for your journey. 

A **Slow Pace** mimics the stalking heron; you move in hushed reverence, eyes tracing the silvered tracks of snails and the hidden tremors of the brush. Here, the land yields its secrets, though the sun may set before the vista changes. A **Normal Pace** is the steady pulse of the pack-mule—purposeful and balanced, covering ground without inviting exhaustion or total oblivion. 

Yet, should you choose a **Fast Pace**, you become as the startled stag. You cover leagues with frantic urgency, but you move as a deafened creature, crashing through the undergrowth. You may reach the city gates by dusk, but you will have blundered past a dozen ambushes and a kingdom of wonders, seeing nothing but the dust rising beneath your boots. Choose wisely, for the land remembers your stride.
